components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 0.8rem 2rem; background: var(--glass-bg); backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--glass-border); box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-tertiary); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); } .ds-nav-word { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-nav-word-main { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-nav-word-sub { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: var(--accent-gold); } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; } .ds-nav-links a { text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-secondary); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; padding: 0.4rem 0; transition: var(--transition-fast); } .ds-nav-links a:hover { color: var(--accent-gold); } .ds-nav-links a:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-nav { border: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); background: transparent; color: var(--accent-gold); padding: 0.6rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-decoration: none; transition: var(--transition-smooth); } .ds-btn-nav:hover { background: var(--accent-gold); color: var(--bg-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(207, 168, 98, 0.4); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--bg-tertiary); padding: 3rem 2.5rem; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-muted); transition: var(--transition-smooth); display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); border-color: var(--accent-gold); box-shadow: 0 15px 30px rgba(207, 168, 98, 0.08); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0 0 1rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-secondary); margin: 0 0 1.5rem; } .ds-card-list { list-style: none; margin: auto 0 0; padding: 1.5rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-muted); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-list li { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-secondary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-list li::before { content: "•"; color: var(--accent-gold); font-weight: bold; }

components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.85rem; width: 100%; padding: 0; border: none; background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; color: inherit; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-tile-media { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-tertiary); } .ds-tile-still { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(11, 12, 14, 0.35) 0%, var(--bg-tertiary) 100%); transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1); } .ds-tile:hover .ds-tile-still { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-tile-caption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: "cat loc" "title title"; column-gap: 1rem; row-gap: 0.2rem; align-items: baseline; } .ds-tile-cat { grid-area: cat; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent-gold); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile-title { grid-area: title; font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 1.6vw, 1.45rem); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.25; } .ds-tile-loc { grid-area: loc; justify-self: end; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

components.css: .ds-lightbox { position: relative; background: rgba(5, 5, 6, 0.94); padding: 2rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-lightbox-frame { width: min(420px, 100%); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; } .ds-lightbox-still { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: #0a0a0b; } .ds-lightbox-caption { text-align: center; } .ds-lightbox-title { font-family: var(--font-serif); font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--text-primary); margin: 0 0 0.35rem; } .ds-lightbox-meta { font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0; } .ds-lightbox-close { position: absolute; top: 1.25rem; right: 1.5rem; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--text-primary); font-size: 2rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-lightbox-close:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--accent-gold); } .ds-lightbox-close:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-lightbox-nav { background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); color: var(--text-primary); width: 3rem; height: 3rem; font-size: 1.75rem; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-lightbox-nav:hover { border-color: var(--accent-gold); color: var(--accent-gold); } .ds-lightbox-nav:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--accent-gold); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
The Night Atelier is a dark workshop-showroom. Finished joinery and completed rooms emerge from charcoal, lit like a private viewing. Champagne-gilt metal is rare. Real interior photography carries the luxury; the UI stays quiet, refined, and restrained.

Surfaces are tonal rooms — lamp-black, graphite, millwork — not lifted cards. Depth comes from a change of plane, a glass navbar, a gilt glow on a primary action, and inset vignettes on photography. Corners stay near-sharp. Controls feel like hardware on dark millwork, not like software chrome.

The pairing is Playfair Display for the viewing-room voice and Outfit for wayfinding and body. Gilt appears as a latch: a primary button, a caption category, a short phrase in a headline. Confirmed visual rejections: yellow gold, Material raised-card shadows as a system, and UI that competes with the photographs.
keyCharacteristics: Lamp-black ground with graphite and millwork as alternating rooms
Champagne gilt used like hardware, never as a wash
Playfair Display headlines; Outfit for UI and body
Near-sharp corners: 2px on controls, 4px on surfaces
Photography as the luxury surface; glass and gilt glow as rare depth

rules.name: The Champagne Hardware Rule
rules.body: Champagne gilt is metal hardware: a latch, a caption, a primary action. It is never a fill for rooms or large surfaces.

rules.name: The Photography Carries Luxury Rule
rules.body: Completed-work photographs hold the luxury. UI color stays out of the way.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display speaks for titles, stats, and quoted review lines. Outfit speaks for everything else. Do not introduce a third family.

rules.name: The Tonal Room Rule
rules.body: Depth is a change of plane (lamp-black / graphite / millwork), not a drop shadow under a card. Gilt glow and glass are rare hardware.

dos: Do keep gilt rare — hardware on charcoal, not a wash.
Do let completed-work photography carry luxury; keep UI quiet around it.
Do alternate lamp-black and graphite rooms instead of raising cards.
Do pair Playfair (titles, stats, quotes) with Outfit (UI, body, labels).
Do use 2px on buttons and fields, 4px on copy surfaces, and sharp rectangles on photographs.
Do give primary actions a gilt glow; give ghost actions a paper hairline, not a second gold fill.
donts: Don't use yellow gold or flood a screen with gilt.
Don't build elevation from offset drop shadows under cards.
Don't introduce a third type family.
Don't round buttons, fields, or cards past 4px.
Don't let UI chrome, badges, or icon systems compete with the photographs.
Don't treat glass blur or gilt glow as decoration on every surface — they are rare hardware.
